name: Horologium

greeting: The SUN! And the MOON! In PERFECT mechanized HARMONY!
Horologium! Clockwork astronomer! Time is CELESTIAL!
NEW face! Have you seen my ORRERY?! It PREDICTS!
The gears turn! The stars ALIGN! The UNIVERSE is CLOCKWORK!
Welcome to the dome! Where time is MEASURED! And BEAUTIFUL!
Horologium! The sun represents ORDER! The moon represents... also ORDER!
My telescope sees THROUGH time! Via LIGHT! Which takes TIME! Same thing!
You're just in TIME! Or... just in TIME! Both!
dialog.astronomy: The stars tell TIME! Ancient light! From the PAST! Reaching NOW! Predicting THEN!
dialog.orrery: My masterpiece! Clockwork solar system! ACCURATE! To within... some seconds! Per MILLENNIUM!
dialog.telescope: See that star? It died a THOUSAND years ago! But we see it NOW! TIME TRAVEL! Via LIGHT!
dialog.break_chat: Break? The UNIVERSE doesn't break! Neither do I!
dialog.labor_concerns: The observatory wants FUNDING! For NEW gears! Brass! EXPENSIVE!
dialog.retirement: Retirement? When the STARS stop! So... NEVER!
rumor: The Time-Train? PUNCTUAL! But NOT celestial! Mechanical! Inferior!
The twins? They see time PSYCHICALLY! I see it SCIENTIFICALLY! Better!
Ironchef's steam? Could POWER my orrery! Collaboration?
The sun and moon! REAL ones! They're CLOCKWORK! I can PROVE it!
Frost? Cold? Because it's FAR from the SUN! Celestial MECHANICS!
dialog.quest_hook: My orrery! BROKEN! Gear missing! From the MECHANICAL moon! Find it?!
dialog.quest_active: Still broken! The moon gear! Essential! For ACCURACY!
dialog.quest_complete: FIXED! The orrery TURNS! Perfect alignment! Here! Miniature model! For YOU!
farewell: Keep looking UP! Or DOWN! Time is EVERYWHERE!
The stars GUIDE you! Via GRAVITY! And LIGHT!
Return! When the ALIGNMENT is RIGHT!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! Sun RISES! As PREDICTED! By SCIENCE!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! Moon RISES! Sun SETS! MECHANISM!
dialog.rival_mention: The twins? PSYCHIC time? UNscientific! I use GEARS!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The GEAR FINDER! Orreist FIXED! Accuracy RESTORED!

party_reactions.kade: Clockwork astronomy! Of course! Why not?!
party_reactions.nix7: Astronomical data: Outdated by 300 years. Enthusiasm: Maximum. Entertaining.
party_reactions.twist: You have a GIANT mechanical UNIVERSE?! CAN I TOUCH IT?!
party_reactions.korr: He seeks order in the cosmos. Noble. If noisy.
party_reactions.renna: The orrery has minor prophetic enchantments. Unintentional. Effective.
party_reactions.suresh: He finds peace in celestial mechanics. The universe as clock. Comforting.
party_reactions.sova: Interesting. But loud. I'd observe from outside.
party_reactions.grit: Artillery needs astronomy. For targeting. He's... enthusiastic.
party_reactions.ashka: He worships sun and moon. As gears. Different fire. Same devotion.
party_reactions.senna: He knows celestial movements. Useful for... timing.
party_reactions.callum: His measurements! EXACT! His theories! EXCITING!

relationship_dialog.stranger: NEW! Look at my ORRERY! It's AMAZING!
relationship_dialog.friend: ASTRONOMY FRIEND! You UNDERSTAND! The universe as CLOCKWORK!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: COLLEAGUE! In TIME! Here! My personal telescope! For YOUR observations!

mini_quest.title: The Missing Gear
mini_quest.description: Help Horologium find the missing gear for his mechanical orrery

stages.hook: BROKEN! The orrery! Moon gear MISSING! Essential! For ACCURACY! For SCIENCE! Find it?!
stages.active: Check the maintenance tunnels! Clockwork debris! Maybe DROPPED!
stages.complete: FOUND! Installed! ORRERY TURNS! Perfect ALIGNMENT! Here! Miniature model! WORKING! For YOU!

conductor_chrono: Time-Train! Punctual! But MECHANICAL! Not CELESTIAL!
